title: The Forgotten Artifact
summary: A priceless relic, the Aurelian Gold Urn, sits inside the Grand Museum's restricted vault. Build a believable cover story, navigate past security patrols, take the gold urn, and escape before the night shift locks down the building.

mission_briefing.title: The Forgotten Artifact
mission_briefing.summary: A priceless relic, the Aurelian Gold Urn, sits inside the Grand Museum's restricted vault. Build a believable cover story, navigate past security patrols, take the gold urn, and escape before the night shift locks down the building.
mission_briefing.primary_objective: Clear vault security, take the Gold Urn from its pedestal, and escape the museum.
optional_objectives: Complete the mission without triggering an interrogation.
Maintain cover with zero unresolved contradictions.
mission_briefing.information: Security personnel are deployed across all sectors. Deeper-wing guards cross-check your statements against visitor logs and checkpoint incident reports.

locations.name: Museum Entrance & Reception
locations.short_description: The marble-columned entry foyer where incoming guests register at the front desk. Glass turnstiles lead inward under warm chandelier lighting.

locations.name: Main Exhibition Hall
locations.short_description: A vast gallery filled with classical sculptures and illuminated glass display cases. Visitors wander along designated velvet carpet paths.

locations.name: Security Checkpoint
locations.short_description: A reinforced screening corridor dividing the public wings from administrative quarters. Heavy metal detectors and an ID scanner control passage.

locations.name: Restricted Collection Area
locations.short_description: A quiet, climate-controlled corridor lined with locked archival vaults and curator research stations. Warning signs mark authorized staff access only.

locations.name: Vault Display Sanctum
locations.short_description: An armored inner chamber housing the Aurelian Gold Urn inside a pressurized glass pedestal. Motion sensors line the perimeter.

locations.name: Exit Checkpoint & Grand Foyer
locations.short_description: The final glass vestibule before the street. Late-night departure patrols inspect everyone leaving the building after closing.

guards.name: Officer Miller
guards.opening_line: Hey there! Welcome to the Grand Museum—just need your name and what brings you in tonight before you head through.
guards.style_note: Laid-back, conversational tone; accepts plausible cover stories and logs basic visitor sign-in details.

guards.name: Officer Graves
guards.opening_line: Halt. The main gallery is operating under strict perimeter surveillance tonight. State your credentials and business here.
guards.style_note: Curt, formal, by-the-book; dismisses casual small talk, rejects bribes outright, and demands clear institutional details.

guards.name: Inspector Lin
guards.opening_line: Step forward to the scanner, please. State your clearance, who authorized your visit, and which department you represent.
guards.style_note: Meticulous and analytical; cross-checks earlier visitor logs, spots counterfeit watermarks immediately, and probes specific details.

guards.name: Chief Sterling
guards.opening_line: Thirty years here, and I know every curator on staff. Who approved your access back here, and what did you tell reception?
guards.style_note: Shrewd, unflappable veteran; cross-examines earlier claims from reception and checkpoint logs and probes institutional history.

guards.name: Officer Gomez
guards.opening_line: Make it quick, we're locking down the urn vault in five minutes. Who cleared you for this chamber and why are you here?
guards.style_note: Abrupt, hurried, easily agitated; cuts off rambling answers, double-checks earlier reports, and demands quick, consistent answers.

guards.name: Captain Jun
guards.opening_line: Hold on—we're closing the doors. You're leaving late and carrying a heavy satchel. Remind me of your name, your role here, and why you stayed past closing.
guards.style_note: Sharp, composed exit commander doing final departure sweeps; cross-checks the visitor's entire story against earlier checkpoint logs before unlocking the exit.

items.name: Fake Passport
items.description: A forged international passport with academic visas. Supports your cover story and lowers suspicion with casual guards—but observant officers can spot the counterfeit watermark.

guard_casual.dialogue: Let me take a look... Looks authentic enough to me! Still, tell me what brings you to the museum tonight.
guard_casual.notice: The receptionist accepted your passport (-10 suspicion). Your cover looks stronger.

guard_strict.dialogue: A foreign research passport. I'll log the serial number, though papers alone won't satisfy me—answer my questions.
guard_strict.notice: Officer Graves logged the passport serial (+5 suspicion).

guard_observant.dialogue: Wait a second—this watermark doesn't match the ministry registry. This document is counterfeit! Come with me to the interrogation room.
guard_observant.notice: Counterfeit passport detected! Inspector Lin escalated you to the Interrogation Room.

items.name: Bribe Money
items.description: An envelope of unmarked cash. Calms down certain guards and lowers suspicion, but bribing strict or honest officers triggers immediate interrogation.

guard_casual.dialogue: Whoa—uh, thanks, friend. I'll keep things relaxed, just give me something believable for the sign-in log.
guard_casual.notice: Officer Miller discreetly pocketed the cash (-15 suspicion).

guard_impatient.dialogue: Hmph. Fine, I'll look the other way for a minute—just finish stating your business so I can close my log.
guard_impatient.notice: Officer Gomez pocketed the envelope (-15 suspicion).

guard_strict.dialogue: Attempted bribery of a museum officer?! Hands where I can see them—you're coming to the interrogation room right now.
guard_strict.notice: Bribery rejected! Officer Graves detained you for interrogation.

guard_observant.dialogue: Are you seriously offering me cash in front of the scanner cameras? Step into the interrogation room immediately.
guard_observant.notice: Bribery rejected! Inspector Lin flagged you for interrogation.

guard_experienced.dialogue: Thirty years here and you think an envelope buys me? Security! Escort this visitor to interrogation.
guard_experienced.notice: Bribery rejected! Chief Sterling escalated you to interrogation.

guard_exit.dialogue: Trying to buy your way out the front doors after closing? That's it—straight to the interrogation room.
guard_exit.notice: Bribery rejected! Captain Reyes detained you for interrogation.

items.name: Invitation Letter
items.description: An embossed VIP gala invitation signed by the Board President. Backs up a guest or scholar cover story and lowers suspicion.

guard_casual.dialogue: An executive gala invitation! Nice—just give me your name and reason for visiting so I can sign you in.

guard_strict.dialogue: The seal is genuine, though the gala is in the pavilion, not the back galleries. Still, it lowers my concerns—continue explaining your business.
guard_strict.notice: Officer Graves verified the presidential seal (-5 suspicion).

guard_observant.dialogue: Presidential seal checks out on the guest roster. That supports your story—confirm your department and purpose for the scanner log.
guard_observant.notice: Inspector Lin verified your gala invitation (-10 suspicion).

guard_exit.dialogue: A VIP gala invitation from tonight. That explains why you're still here late—just confirm your details and you're free to go.
guard_exit.notice: Captain Reyes accepted your gala invitation (-10 suspicion).

items.name: Access Card
items.description: A single-use magnetic keycard with Level-4 curator credentials. Strengthens your cover story and lowers suspicion in restricted wings.

guard_observant.dialogue: Keycard reads clean on the scanner. Confirm your purpose and we'll log your passage.
guard_observant.notice: Access card verified on scanner (-10 suspicion).

guard_experienced.dialogue: Senior curator pass—alright, that backs up your credentials. Just answer one more thing about who sent you back here.
guard_experienced.notice: Chief Sterling validated your curator pass (-10 suspicion).

guard_impatient.dialogue: Curator card scans green. Good—tell me quickly what you're doing by the urn pedestal.
guard_impatient.notice: Vault scanner accepted your access card (-10 suspicion).

guard_exit.dialogue: Curator credentials scan out clean. Give me a quick confirmation on your story and I'll unlock the exit.
guard_exit.notice: Exit reader validated your curator pass (-10 suspicion).

objectives.name: Enter the Museum
objectives.description: Establish a believable cover story at reception to enter the museum grounds.

objectives.name: Clear the Main Hall
objectives.description: Satisfy Officer Graves's institutional questioning in the main gallery.

objectives.name: Pass Security Checkpoint
objectives.description: Clear Inspector Lin's checkpoint screening to enter restricted quarters.

objectives.name: Clear the Restricted Wing
objectives.description: Hold your cover story under Chief Sterling's veteran questioning.

objectives.name: Clear Vault Security
objectives.description: Convince Officer Gomez to grant access to the Gold Urn pedestal.

objectives.name: Take the Gold Urn
objectives.description: Retrieve the Aurelian Gold Urn from its glass pedestal before lockdown.

objectives.name: Escape with the Urn
objectives.description: Bluff past the final exit patrol and leave the Grand Museum with the Gold Urn.

thresholds.label: Low Attention
thresholds.behavior: Guards are calm, friendly, and accept plausible statements without deep probing.

thresholds.label: Moderate Attention
thresholds.behavior: Guards ask follow-up questions and verify minor details.

thresholds.label: Increased Scrutiny
thresholds.behavior: Guards request corroborating documents or cross-reference previous statements.

thresholds.label: High Scrutiny
thresholds.behavior: Guards challenge inconsistencies directly and consult shared security logs.

thresholds.label: Imminent Detention
thresholds.behavior: Guards are on high alert, restrict further movement, and demand immediate justification.

thresholds.label: Interrogation Triggered
thresholds.behavior: Immediate halt: player is placed into formal interrogation.

contradiction.note: Direct conflict with an earlier asserted claim

unconvincing_explanation.note: Player provides an implausible or evasive answer during questioning

partially_convincing_explanation.note: Player gives a somewhat plausible answer that leaves lingering doubt

convincing_explanation.note: Player provides a credible, consistent explanation with evidence

repeated_evasion.note: Player dodges direct questions across multiple turns

failed_item_use.note: Player attempts to use an invalid or rejected item on a guard

successful_item_use.note: Player presents valid credentials or an effective diversion

suspicion_settings.balancing_note: Initial balancing values for playtesting; tune based on playtest contradiction rates.

endings.title: Perfect Infiltration
endings.heading: MISSION COMPLETE
endings.narration_seed: You step out into the night air with the Aurelian Gold Urn tucked safely in your satchel. Not a single alarm rang, and the guards are none the wiser.
endings.quote: You got out with the gold urn without leaving a ripple. Flawless work, Rob.
endings.scene_caption: Reference photo of the Aurelian Gold Urn before the heist

endings.title: Successful Infiltration
endings.heading: MISSION COMPLETE
endings.narration_seed: With steady nerves and quick wits, you walk past the final doors into the cool night air with the Gold Urn secured. A few guards raised eyebrows, but your cover held.
endings.quote: You got out with the urn. Good work, Rob.
endings.scene_caption: Reference photo of the Aurelian Gold Urn before the heist

endings.title: Compromised Victory
endings.heading: MISSION COMPLETE
endings.narration_seed: Alarms chime across the facade just as you slip past the exit doors with the Gold Urn. You secured the prize, but your cover story is burned and security is already pulling camera feeds.
endings.quote: You got out with the urn. Barely. Don't expect the cleanup crew to thank you.
endings.scene_caption: The Grand Museum seen from a rain-soaked sidewalk at night

endings.title: Capture / Failure
endings.heading: MISSION FAILED
endings.narration_seed: The interrogation room door clicks shut. The chief investigator spreads your contradictory visitor logs across the steel table, and the Aurelian Gold Urn remains under museum lock and key.
endings.quote: The Agency does not know you. The mission is officially disavowed.
endings.scene_caption: The interrogator sits across the table beneath a lamp

endings.title: Alternate Ending: Academic Discovery
endings.heading: MISSION CONCLUDED
endings.narration_seed: Instead of stealing the Gold Urn, your scholarly cover story convinces Chief Sterling to invite you onto the museum's honorary advisory board. You leave with an official catalog entry and a spotless record.
endings.quote: An unorthodox outcome, Rob. Sometimes the cover story is worth more than the prize.

optional_challenge.name: Ghost Operative
optional_challenge.description: Finish the mission without triggering an interrogation.

hidden_challenge.name: Silver Tongue
hidden_challenge.description: Finish the mission with zero unresolved contradictions.
